svg.title: A hierarchy of reusable contour features
svg.desc: A handwritten five supplies short oriented edges in Level 1 feature maps. Combinations of edges form corners, arcs, and longer lines in Level 2 feature maps. Exemplar-specific landmark pools read these shared maps. Lateral links connect the pools within each exemplar. Three exemplar nodes represent five, three, and seven. Selected maps and schematic pool connections are shown.
